source.jql: filter = YOUR_FILTER AND statusCategory = Done AND type = bug AND fixVersion is EMPTY

branchToFixVersion._notes: Look up Jira version IDs at: Jira project → Project settings → Versions → click a version (ID is in the URL). Branches with id and name both empty-string are intentionally ignored (non-release/experimental branches).

upcoming_changes._doc: Add entries here when a branch naming or version cutover is coming. The agent warns when a date is within 7 days or up to 30 days past.
upcoming_changes.description: Branch naming cutover for next release cycle — update branchToFixVersion
